info.title: Anywhere Cloud Console API
info.description:
AWC Console REST API for managing clusters, blueprints, and blueprint deployments.

This API provides:
- Cluster creation and management
- Blueprint catalog browsing
- Blueprint deployment (a deployed blueprint instance) management
- Real-time status updates via Server-Sent Events (SSE)
- Integration with Taikun API for cluster provisioning

## SSE Support

The following endpoints provide Server-Sent Events (SSE) for real-time updates:
- `GET /api/v1/console/clusters/events` - SSE stream for cluster updates
- `GET /api/v1/console/blueprint-deployments/events` - SSE stream for blueprint deployment updates

**SSE Behavior:**
- Initial data sent immediately upon connection
- Updates sent only when data changes (efficient, not every N seconds)
- Keepalive comments (`: keepalive`) sent every 30 seconds if no data updates
- Change detection using SHA-256 hash of JSON payload
- Supports the same query filters as the corresponding JSON list endpoint

SSE streams are not paginated; each `data:` frame carries the full snapshot array.

get.description: Returns service and API version information

Returns blueprint parent tiles flattened across all catalogs, each with
its registry-present version drill-down. Pass `catalog_id` to scope to a
single catalog. The version `blueprint_version_id` is the deploy entry
point for creating a blueprint deployment.

get.summary: Get a single blueprint with its full version drill-down
get.description:
Returns one blueprint parent with its full version drill-down, including
resolved engine instances (with config forms), node group requirements,
and jointly-supported Kubernetes versions. `blueprint_id` is globally unique.

Returns all cloud credentials visible to the current Taikun user, each with
its associated provider and region. Data is fetched from the Taikun API.

Use the optional `cloud_credential_id` filter to scope the list to a single
credential.

parameters.name: cloud_credential_id
parameters.description:
When provided, the response is filtered to the single credential with
this ID. Returns 404 if the credential is not found.

200.description: List of cloud credentials with infrastructure details

get.description:
Returns available VM flavors (instance types) from the Taikun API for a
cloud credential, with orthogonal optional resource filters.

- `cloud_credential_id` — fetch flavors from this credential; when omitted,
  the project-default credential is used.
- `min_cpu` / `min_memory` — raw Kubernetes quantity strings (e.g. `8`,
  `32Gi`); the server parses them and returns flavors meeting or exceeding
  the bar. Pass the node group's declared requirement verbatim.
- `gpu` — when `true`, only GPU-enabled flavors; when `false`, only non-GPU
  flavors; when omitted, both.

parameters.name: cloud_credential_id
parameters.description:
Cloud credential to fetch flavors from (as returned by
`GET /api/v1/console/infrastructure`). When omitted, the project-default
credential is used. Returns 404 if the ID is not found.

parameters.name: min_cpu
parameters.description:
Minimum CPU as a raw Kubernetes quantity string, parsed server-side
(e.g. `8`, `500m`). Flavors below this are excluded.

parameters.name: min_memory
parameters.description:
Minimum memory as a raw Kubernetes quantity string, parsed server-side
(e.g. `32Gi`, `16G`). Flavors below this are excluded.

parameters.name: gpu
parameters.description: When set, filter flavors by GPU support.

get.description:
Returns a JSON snapshot of all Kubernetes clusters that have been deployed.

For real-time updates, use `GET /api/v1/console/clusters/events` (SSE).
The `status` filter is case-insensitive.

delete.description:
Initiates deletion of a cluster and all its blueprint deployments.

Returns `202 Accepted` immediately; deletion runs asynchronously (the
backing Taikun project is force-deleted, then polled until gone, then the
rows are removed). Subscribe to `GET /api/v1/console/clusters/events` (SSE)
to track progress. On failure the cluster status is set to `delete_failed`
with a reason and the DELETE can be retried.

409.description: Cluster deletion is already in progress

get.description:
Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream for real-time cluster updates.

Initial data is sent immediately; further frames are sent only when the
data changes (SHA-256 change detection). Keepalive comments (`: keepalive`)
are sent every 30 seconds when idle. Accepts the same `status` filter as
the JSON list endpoint.

schema.description:
Server-Sent Events stream. Each `data:` frame contains a JSON
array of Cluster objects (same shape as the JSON list `data`).
Frames sent only when the data changes; keepalive comments every
30 seconds.

get.description:
Returns a JSON snapshot of all blueprint deployments (deployed blueprint
instances) across all clusters.

For real-time updates, use `GET /api/v1/console/blueprint-deployments/events`
(SSE).

parameters.name: cluster_id
parameters.description: Filter by numeric cluster ID (not the formatted `cluster-NNN` string)

post.description:
Deploys a blueprint by atomically provisioning a new Kubernetes cluster
and installing the blueprint (identified by `blueprint_version_id`) onto
it in a single call. Returns `202 Accepted` immediately; provisioning and
deployment proceed asynchronously. Track progress via
`GET /api/v1/console/blueprint-deployments/events` (SSE).

Pass `dry_run=true` to run pre-flight checks (e.g. flavor existence,
OpenStack quota) without persisting or creating any resources; the
response reports validity and any errors and nothing is persisted.

For a multi-instance blueprint, only the primary blueprint deployment is
returned in the 202 body; additional per-instance deployments are created
server-side and are discoverable via `GET /api/v1/console/blueprint-deployments`.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description:
When true, validate the request and run pre-flight checks (flavor
existence, OpenStack quota) without persisting or creating resources.
Returns `200` with a validation result instead of `202`.

409.description:
A name conflict occurred. Either the desired cluster name is already
taken (`CLUSTER_NAME_CONFLICT`) or the blueprint deployment instance
name is already taken (`BLUEPRINT_DEPLOYMENT_NAME_CONFLICT`).

get.description:
Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream for real-time blueprint deployment updates.

Initial data is sent immediately; further frames are sent only when the
data changes (SHA-256 change detection). Keepalive comments (`: keepalive`)
are sent every 30 seconds when idle. Accepts the same `status` and
`cluster_id` filters as the JSON list endpoint.

200.description: SSE stream of blueprint deployment updates

schema.description:
Server-Sent Events stream. Each `data:` frame contains a JSON
array of BlueprintDeployment objects (same shape as the JSON list
`data`). Frames sent only when the data changes; keepalive
comments every 30 seconds.

post.description:
Triggers a resync of the marketplace catalog from its OCI registries.
Internal operational endpoint; not exposed through the gateway.

get.summary: List available Anywhere Cloud upgrade versions
get.description:
Returns upgrade candidate versions newer than the currently running release,
ordered by release date descending (newest first). Each item includes its
release date and the highest CVE severity fixed relative to its immediate
predecessor. The running version is excluded from this list; `is_current` is
reserved and always false on listed items.

post.description:
Triggers an upgrade of the Anywhere Cloud control plane to the specified
version.

This endpoint is idempotent: calling it while an upgrade is already in
progress (or has failed) acts as a retry. The upgrade is orchestrated
asynchronously. Returns `202 Accepted` immediately; use
`GET /api/v1/console/upgrade/status` to poll for progress.

get.description:
Returns the current state of the Anywhere Cloud upgrade process, including
ordered steps and substeps with their individual statuses.

**Polling behavior:**
- Call once on page load to determine if an upgrade is active.
- If `status` is `in_progress`, poll every ~5 seconds.
- Stop polling when `status` is `not_started`, `completed`, or `failed`.
- After calling `POST /api/v1/console/upgrade`, begin polling.

**Status semantics:**
- `completed` requires both the Taikun umbrella deployment and all changed
  platform component releases to be healthy. Completion may lag umbrella
  readiness while components finish rolling out.
- After umbrella readiness, the Rolling Upgrade step may gain additional
  dynamic substeps (one per upgraded component). Substep names vary by
  release and are not fixed across versions.
- `completed` reflects the most recent upgrade attempt and persists until a new upgrade is started.
- Failure detail is carried on step and substep `status_reason` fields.
- The rollout workflow times out after 15 minutes; if Taikun completes later,
  call `POST /api/v1/console/upgrade` again with the same `target_version`.

**Note:** During the upgrade, Anywhere Cloud may experience brief downtime.
The client should handle connection failures gracefully and retry.

engines.description:
The blueprint's engine instances, each resolved to the engine's
latest version and its config form. Returned only by the
single-blueprint detail endpoint; omitted in the list.

hardware_tiers.description:
Hardware tiers declared by this blueprint version. Each tier carries its
own cluster topology (Kubernetes version + node group requirements). The
deploy wizard renders one option per tier and drives the node-group forms
and flavor filtering from the selected tier. Returned only by the
single-blueprint detail endpoint; omitted in the list.

BlueprintEngine.description:
One engine instance of a blueprint version, resolved to the engine's
latest version and its UI config form. Inlined on the blueprint detail
response so the configure screen can render from a single call.

name.description: Stable machine name of the engine

display_name.description: Human-readable engine name (from the pinned latest version)

description.description: Short description of the engine (from the pinned latest version)

version.description: Pinned engine version string (the engine's latest)

config_schema.description:
UI config form derived from the pinned engine version's config schema.
Omitted when the engine version declares no config.

requires_embedded_registry.description: When true, deployment requires Taikun OS-level registry trust setup

BlueprintNodeGroup.description:
One node group requirement from the blueprint cluster spec, passed through
verbatim. ACE passthrough carve-out: the declared property names are
snake_case, but nested object shapes below mirror the upstream ACE
blueprint schema and their inner values are not renamed.

optional.description: When true, this node group may be skipped during provisioning

node_count.description: Node count requirement, passed through from the ACE blueprint schema.

resources.description: Resource requirement, passed through verbatim from the ACE blueprint schema (inner values not renamed).

storage.description: Storage requirement, passed through verbatim from the ACE blueprint schema (inner values not renamed).

HardwareTierClusterConfig.description:
Cluster configuration template for one hardware tier, sourced from the
blueprint's tier definition. Backs the deploy wizard's cluster form.

kubernetes_version.description:
Kubernetes version for this tier's workload cluster: the tier's declared
version, surfaced only when Taikun can currently provision it.

node_groups.description: Node group requirements for this tier (see BlueprintNodeGroup).

HardwareTier.description: One hardware tier declared by a blueprint version.

name.description:
Tier identifier. Submitted back as `hardware_tier` on
CreateBlueprintDeploymentRequest to select this tier's topology.

ConfigSchemaEngine.description:
Engine config form passed through from the ACE engine config schema. Field
names are snake_case; nested `input_fields` shapes and any dynamic values
mirror upstream ACE (passthrough carve-out).

description.description: Optional engine description shown in UI cards.

input_fields.description: Dynamic form fields rendered when configuring this engine.

name.description: Field key used in the ace_instance_info payload.

type.description: Discriminator for field renderer and validation behavior.

description.description: Optional helper text shown below the field.

example.description: Sample value shown as placeholder text when the field is empty.

sensitive.description: Marks a string field as sensitive; UI renders masked input.

example.description: Sample value shown as placeholder text when the field is empty.

label.description: Human-readable text displayed to the user.

value.description: Machine-readable value submitted in the ace_instance_info payload.

options.description: List of mutually exclusive options rendered as radio buttons.

cloud_credential_name.description: Human-readable cloud credential name from Taikun

provider.description: Cloud provider type (e.g. OPENSTACK, AWS, AZURE)

Flavor.description:
A VM flavor from the Taikun API. No description field is available in the
Taikun response.

gpu.description: Whether this flavor has GPU support, as reported by the cloud provider.

Human-readable explanation of the current status. Present when status
is `failed`; omitted when there is nothing to report.

Fully-qualified URL to download diagnostics bundles for the cluster.
Omitted when no diagnostics are available.

nodes.description: Total number of nodes (bastion + masters + workers)

cloud_credential_name.description: Cloud credential name used to provision this cluster.

provider.description: Cloud provider type for the credential used to provision this cluster.

cluster_id.description: Formatted cluster ID where the blueprint is deployed

cluster_name.description: Cluster name where the blueprint is deployed

status_reason.description:
Human-readable explanation of the current status. Present when status
is `failed`; omitted when there is nothing to report.
status_reason.example: Helm install failed: timed out waiting for the condition

version.description: Deployed blueprint version (chart version). Omitted when not set.

landing_page_url.description:
URL to the deployed blueprint's landing page. Set after successful
deployment; omitted until the app reports its URL.

cloud_credential_name.description: Cloud credential name used to provision the cluster this deployment runs on.

provider.description: Cloud provider type for the credential of the cluster this deployment runs on.

disk_size.description: Disk size in GB (converted to bytes internally by the backend)

count.description: Number of nodes in this group

disk_size.description: Disk size in GB (converted to bytes internally by the backend)

master_node_groups.description: One or more master node groups

worker_node_groups.description: One or more worker node groups

name.description: Desired blueprint deployment instance name (must be unique, DNS-1123 compliant)

cluster_name.description: Desired cluster name (must be unique, DNS-1123 compliant)

blueprint_version_id.description:
Blueprint version to deploy; a `blueprint_version_id` from the
blueprint catalog drill-down (`GET /api/v1/console/blueprints/{blueprint_id}`).

version.description: Blueprint version string to record; should match blueprint_version_id

hardware_tier.description:
Name of the selected hardware tier (a `name` from the blueprint detail's
`hardware_tiers`). Determines the cluster topology template; defaults to
the blueprint's default tier when omitted.

engine_versions.description:
Optional per-instance engine version overrides. Keys must be blueprint
instance names (not engine package names); values are semver strings.
Omitted instances use the catalog default for the blueprint version.

cloud_credential_id.description:
Cloud credential to provision the cluster with. Obtain IDs from
`GET /api/v1/console/infrastructure`.

compute_infrastructure.description:
Display label for the compute infrastructure (optional; derived from
the cloud credential when omitted).

cidr.description: CIDR block for the cluster network (optional; Taikun default when omitted)

ace_instance_info.description:
User-provided configuration for ACE engine instances. Keys are engine
IDs; each value is an object of dynamic field inputs for that engine,
merged with the blueprint's config template at deploy time. ACE
passthrough carve-out: inner keys/values mirror upstream ACE and are
not renamed.

valid.description: True if all pre-flight checks passed

errors.description: List of validation errors (empty when valid is true)
example: Insufficient OpenStack quota: need 5 instances but only 2 available (limit 20, used 18)

UpgradeVersion.description: One Anywhere Cloud version available for upgrade.

release_date.description:
Release date (ISO 8601 date) when available. Currently always emitted
as an empty string: the upstream package-versions source provides no
release metadata. Consumers must tolerate "".

is_current.description: True when this is the currently running Anywhere Cloud version.

fixed_cve_severity.description:
Highest CVE severity fixed in this release relative to its immediate
predecessor. Null when the release contains no CVE fixes.

target_version.description: Version to upgrade Anywhere Cloud to (must be from the available versions list)

status.description:
Overall upgrade status:
- not_started: No upgrade in progress
- in_progress: Upgrade is actively running
- completed: Upgrade finished successfully
- failed: Upgrade encountered an error (can retry via POST /api/v1/console/upgrade)

target_version.description: Version being upgraded to. Null when status is idle.

steps.description:
Ordered list of upgrade steps. Array position determines execution order.
Empty when status is idle.

name.description: Step title displayed in the UI

description.description: Human-readable description of what this step does

status_reason.description:
Error message when status is failed, propagated from the failed substep.
Null for non-failed statuses.

substeps.description:
Ordered list of substeps within this step. Array position determines
execution order. Rolling Upgrade adds dynamic component substeps after
the three fixed rollout substeps.

name.description: Substep label displayed in the UI

status_reason.description:
Error message when status is failed. This is the original error source
that gets propagated to the parent step's status_reason.

ServiceUnavailable.description:
A required dependency (Taikun API or database) is temporarily
unavailable, so the request could not be serviced. The client may retry.

JwtAuthentication.description:
HTTP Authorization Bearer header using a JWT. Authentication is enforced
upstream at the Knox gateway; the service runs no in-process auth
middleware. Declared for documentation of the expected credential only.
